1790.stem: It is given that $y$ is inversely proportional to $x$. When $x=8$, $y=2$.

figures.cap: solution sketch: hyperbola y=16/x with points (1.6,10) and (-10,-1.6) marked

parts.latex: Graph the relationship showing two different points on the graph.

solutions.latex:
$y$ is inversely proportional to $x$, so $y=\dfrac{k}{x}$, that is $xy=k$. Substitute $x=8$, $y=2$:
$$\begin{aligned} xy &= k \\ k &= 8\times 2 \\ &= 16 \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ y=\dfrac{16}{x}$$

meta.top_criterion_original: Correct equation. Many solutions had taken the relationship as direct proportion. As this simplifies the question, no mark was given here or in part (b) below. Only correct answers from part (a) received marks.
